about: Validation rules for data/model-prices.json, shared by scripts/check-model-prices.py and src/data/model-prices.ts. The refresh job edits model-prices.json only; changes to this file (new units, new source hosts) need review.

usd_per_1m_tokens.label: Text tokens: USD per 1 million tokens (standard tier, global processing)

usd_per_1m_image_tokens.label: Image tokens: USD per 1 million image tokens

usd_per_video_second.label: Video: USD per second of generated video

flow_credits_per_generation.label: Google Flow: credits per video generation

flow_credits_per_second.label: Google Flow: credits per second of generated video

flow_credits_per_month.label: Google Flow: extra credits per month included with a Google AI plan

usd_per_gpu_hour.label: Midjourney: USD per extra Fast GPU hour

suno_credits_per_song.label: Suno: credits charged per song generation
